messages:
alex: quick handoff from night shift — async standup. TL;DR: two small incidents seen, both mitigated. leaving a few follow-ups. please ack and take anything you own.

alex: INCIDENTS
- INC-3245 embeddings spike (~02:15 UTC): sudden 3x read latency on embed-store leading to increased queue depth. Mitigation: scaled embed-workers + bumped read-replica pool; enabled short-term KV prefix caching for hot keys. Canary rolled and looks stable (p95 token latency back to baseline). links: https://logs.redwood/ingest/INC-3245 | runbook: /runbooks/embeddings-cache.md :thumbsup:
- INC-3246 eu-region routing flaps (~03:40 UTC): LB returned 502s for a subset of hosts after a bad config deploy. Mitigation: rolled back route change and drained bad hosts. No data loss; downstream retries handled it.

alex: WHAT I DID
- ran quick canary for embed cache patch (canary->stable if metrics stay green)
- rolled back EU route change and validated healthchecks
- left a sticky note in the runbook about improving healthcheck alert thresholds

alex: BLOCKERS / TODO
- cleanup-kv job intermittently fails with OOM while compacting a specific shard — stacktrace points at jemalloc behavior. I couldn't repro locally. Need deeper trace and heap profile.
- follow-up: add a slow-path alert for embed cache miss ratio if >2% for 10m (I left a ticket)

alex: NEXT STEPS / OWNERS
- maria: can you pick up the cleanup-kv investigation? start with heap profiles + prod OOM logs. ticket: RW-4812
- jitendra: can you confirm canary metrics for embed patch this morning and decide on full rollout? check: p50/p95/p99, error rate, token throughput (I left the dashboard link).
- sam: please tweak EU LB healthcheck alert to include host-level 502 spikes >5% over 3m — otherwise we get noisy paging.

alex: quick commands I ran:
```
# scale embed workers
redwoodctl svc scale embed-workers --replicas=8 --region=us-west
# rollback route change
redwoodctl routes rollback eu-routing-v2
```

maria: acked, picking up RW-4812 now. will grab heap profiles and post logs here when I have them. planning to attach pprof and check jemalloc tunables.

jitendra: saw the canary dashboards — p95 looks good but p99 has a small blip at 02:18. I'll run a couple of synthetic load tests and run the eval harness against the canary model. if green, I'll promote later today.

sam: re: LB alerts — on it. will open a PR to adjust thresholds and add an auto-silence for planned deploy windows.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: `canary/embed-cache-patch v2 -> canary` (2026-03-17T03:05:12Z) :rocket:

opsbot: reminder: overnight oncall checklist not completed — please ensure handoff doc updated and that next oncall confirms ownership.

alex: thanks all. maria/jitendra tag me on updates. I'm handing off — next oncall is jitendra for the day shift. ping here once you have follow-ups. :eyes:
